exercises.question: Which sentence describes a realistic future condition? [¿Cuál describe una condición futura realista?]
options: Si perdemos el tren, cogeremos el siguiente. [If we miss the train, we will take the next one.]
Si perdiéramos el tren, cogeríamos el siguiente. [If we missed the train, we would take the next one.]
Si perderíamos el tren, cogeríamos el siguiente. [If we would miss the train, we would take the next one.]

exercises.sentence: Si __ el tren, cogeremos el siguiente. [If we miss the train, we will take the next one.] (perder)

exercises.english: If we miss the train, we will take the next one.

sentences: Si perdemos la conexión, buscamos una alternativa. [If we miss the connection, we look for an alternative.]
Si encontramos otra ruta, continuaremos. [If we find another route, we will continue.]
Así podremos llegar al destino. [That way we can reach the destination.]

exercises.question: Which sentence is hypothetical? [¿Cuál es hipotética?]
options: Si tuviera más tiempo, viajaría por la costa. [If I had more time, I would travel along the coast.]
Si tengo más tiempo, viajaré por la costa. [If I have more time, I will travel along the coast.]
Tengo más tiempo y viajo por la costa. [I have more time and I travel along the coast.]

exercises.sentence: Si __ la conexión, tendríamos que buscar otro alojamiento. [If we missed the connection, we would have to find other accommodation.] (perder)

exercises.english: If we missed the connection, we would have to find other accommodation.

exercises.sentence: Si perdemos el tren, cogeremos el siguiente.
options: If we miss the train, we will take the next one.
If we missed the train, we took the next one yesterday.
If we would miss the train, we take the next one.

exercises.sentence: Si tuviera más tiempo, viajaría por la costa.
options: If I had more time, I would travel along the coast.
If I have more time, I will travel along the coast.
I travelled along the coast because I had more time.

exercises.sentence: Si perdiéramos la conexión, tendríamos que buscar otro alojamiento.
Si hay una alternativa, cambiaremos de ruta.
options: If there is an alternative, we will change route.
If there were an alternative, we changed route yesterday.
There was an alternative, so we changed route.
Cogeremos el siguiente y avisaremos al alojamiento. [We will take the next one and notify the accommodation.]
Cogeríamos el siguiente ayer. [We would take the next one yesterday.]
Cogemos el siguiente cuando lo habíamos perdido. [We take the next one when we had missed it.]

prompt.speaker: A
prompt.text: ¿Qué harías si tuvieras una semana más?

options: Viajaría por la costa y visitaría varias ciudades. [I would travel along the coast and visit several cities.]
Viajaré por la costa ayer. [I will travel along the coast yesterday.]
Viajaba por la costa mañana. [I used to travel along the coast tomorrow.]
Buscaremos una alternativa si el primer tren no llega. [We will look for an alternative if the first train does not arrive.]
Buscaríamos una alternativa si el primer tren no llegará. [We would look for an alternative if the first train will not arrive.]
Buscamos una alternativa ayer si el tren no llegaba mañana. [We look for an alternative yesterday if the train was not arriving tomorrow.]

template.prompt: Give a realistic travel contingency using si + present + future.
template.answer: Si perdemos el tren, cogeremos el siguiente.

template.prompt: Give a hypothetical travel plan using si + imperfect subjunctive + conditional.
template.answer: Si tuviera más tiempo, viajaría por la costa.
